mapper.select: SELECT id, normalized_url AS normalizedUrl, url_hash AS urlHash, domain, title, site_name AS siteName, summary, source, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM link_card WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, normalized_url AS normalizedUrl, url_hash AS urlHash, domain, title, site_name AS siteName, summary, source, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM link_card WHERE url_hash = #{urlHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO link_card (normalized_url, url_hash, domain, title, site_name, summary, source, expires_at) VALUES (#{normalizedUrl}, #{urlHash}, #{domain}, #{title}, #{siteName}, #{summary}, #{source}, #{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES (title), site_name = VALUES (site_name), summary = VALUES (summary), source = VALUES (source), expires_at = VALUES (expires_at)
